title: Reading Between the Layers: Where Representation Quality Lives, and What Geometry Reveals
abstract: arXiv:2611.31496v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Representation quality in pretrained text foundation models is not concentrated at the final layer, yet practitioners routinely probe it there because layer selection without labels has remained an open problem. We present a large-scale empirical study of where layer quality lives across 25 models spanning four architectural families and four pretraining strategies, evaluated on 13 datasets across classification, pair classification, semantic textual similarity, and multiple-choice question answering. Peak probing layers depend systematically on pretraining strategy and architecture: masked encoders peak in late-middle layers, sequence-to-sequence models shift their peak with task type, contrastive sentence encoders concentrate signal at the final layer under CLS and last-token readouts but peak early under mean pooling, and decoder-only models exhibit distinct phase structure tied to depth. translated_title: 层间细读：表征质量究竟藏于何处，几何结构又揭示了什么
translated_abstract: 预训练文本基础模型中的表征质量并非集中于最后一层，然而由于无标签情况下的层选择一直是悬而未决的难题，实践者通常习惯在最后一层进行探测。我们对层质量在何处达到峰值开展了一项大规模实证研究，涵盖25个模型，横跨四种架构族和四种预训练策略，并在13个数据集上进行评估，任务包括分类、成对分类、语义文本相似度和多项选择题问答。峰值探测层系统性地依赖于预训练策略和架构：掩码编码器在中后层达到峰值；序列到序列模型的峰值随任务类型而变化；对比式句子编码器在CLS和末词元读出方式下信号集中于最后一层，但在平均池化下峰值出现在较早层；仅解码器模型则展现出与深度相关的独特阶段结构。我们将这些发现提炼为稳定几何……
tldr: 该论文通过对25个模型、13个数据集的大规模实证研究，系统揭示了预训练语言模型的最佳表征层随预训练策略与架构而系统性变化（掩码编码器峰值在中后层、序列到序列模型随任务类型偏移、对比编码器取决于读出方式、仅解码器模型呈阶段结构），为无标签层选择这一开放问题提供了实证指引。
en_tdlr: Through a large-scale empirical study of 25 models across four architectural families evaluated on 13 datasets, this paper reveals that peak probing layers systematically depend on pretraining strategy and architecture—masked encoders peak in late-middle layers, seq2seq models shift peaks by task type, contrastive encoders depend on readout method, and decoder-only models exhibit depth-tied phase structure—providing guidance for the open problem of label-free layer selection.
